string_format.description: Channel Mapping: A0 = NH3, A1 = H2S OP1 (WE), A2 = H2S OP2 (AE), A3 = VOC

calibration.note: Alphasense method only. source 'site_zero' = zero measured on this station in clean air (AAN 803-05 'Initial calibration'; Alphasense: the cleanest part of the day), sensitivity from the factory sheet; source 'factory' = the sensor's own Alphasense factory calibration sheet; source 'datasheet' = Alphasense's published typical values (indicative). H2S (ppb) = ((A1 - WE zero) - (A2 - AE zero)) / sensitivity; NH3 (ppm) = (A0 - WE zero) / sensitivity; VOC (ppm) = (A3 - V zero) / sensitivity. A channel stuck at the ADC rail is a sensor fault. No temperature tables, filtering or smoothing.

h2s.sheet_values: Site zero: median output 02:00-05:00 Dubai time on 29 and 31 Oct and 1, 2 and 3 Nov 2026 (899 readings). WE zero 458 mV, AE zero 359 mV. Factory sheet: WE (OP1) zero 395 mV, AE (OP2) zero 362 mV, sensitivity 1.727952 mV/ppb = 1727.952 mV/ppm (kept).

nh3.sheet_values: Site zero: median output 02:00-05:00 Dubai time on 29 and 31 Oct and 1, 2 and 3 Nov 2026 (899 readings). WE zero 420 mV. Factory sheet 77840031: WE zero 328 mV; 73.28 nA/ppm x 0.8 mV/nA (ISB gain) = 58.624 mV/ppm (kept).

voc.sheet_values: PIDX-A-040 datasheet: offset voltage 40-100 mV (midpoint 70 mV used); typical sensitivity 55 mV/ppm +/-10%; output signal from 0.040 V (below = fault). Replace with the PID factory sheet.
